neighbours.label: a number joined to a unit, right at the unit or the join (12-|v|olt, 100-m|icro|gram, 300 metric ton, one ampere, 5000-horsepower), as opposed to the same nouns with an ordinary modifier
fire: The kit includes a 9-volt battery and a small switch.
Each pill holds a 500-milligram dose of the drug.
A single 200 metric ton crane lifted the deck.
A current of one ampere passes through the coil.
They built a 3000-horsepower engine for the ship.
The city added a per-gallon fee on fuel.
We walked a 10-kilometer loop around the lake.
A 40-watt lamp hangs over the table.
quiet: The kit includes a spare battery and a small switch.
Each pill holds a large dose of the drug.
A single rusty old crane lifted the deck.
A stream of water passes through the coil.
They built a new engine for the ship.
The city added a small fee on fuel.
We walked a short loop around the lake.
A green lamp hangs over the table.

notes: Peak varies among the digit, the hyphen and the first unit piece.
